subject: Re: Kickoff: DPOK fine-tuning for the image-gen stack
body:
Status + a trade-off that needs a call.

Single-prompt reproduction: done (March 27). With reward weight 10 and kl_weight 0.01, ImageReward scores on the held-out renders improve 21% over the base model, and the KL term is doing its job — samples stay on-distribution instead of collapsing to reward-hacky textures.

Multi-prompt is where the trade-off bites. Our internal preference reward model is noisier than ImageReward; at kl_weight 0.01 the policy starts drifting on faces and text-in-image prompts around step 8k. Raising kl_weight to 0.03 stabilizes it but gives back about a third of the fidelity win. Options: (a) accept 0.03 and a smaller but robust win for the May demo, (b) hold 0.01 with early stopping per prompt cluster, more babysitting but bigger wins.

Also hit the documented hang — fixed exactly as the release notes say, uninstall torch_xla and pin accelerate 0.17.0. Rosa's container has it baked now.

Tereza
